# `symmark`

[Feature reference](0_home.md)

**Module:** core

**Kind:** node feature

## Description

editorial marks that were written inside this sign's reading and are not part of the sign: `()` uncertain word division, `〈〉` editorial insertion, `˽` a spacing mark. Removed from `sym` so it is a clean reading; kept here verbatim.
